label: GmrSD system
definition: A type IV modification-dependent restriction system in which an organism possesses a GmrSD locus encoding either separate GmrS and GmrD proteins or a fused double-domain GmrSD-family protein, that targets glucosylated hydroxymethylcytosine-containing DNA.
observations: GmrSD branch under type IV modification-dependent restriction system; distinct from TgvAB, HEC-05, HEC-06, McrA, McrBC, MspJI, PvuRts1I, EcoKMcrA, ScoMcrA, TagI, VcaM4I, broad RM_Type_IV and Other_Type_IV keys, the GmrSD_RM_Type_IV source key outside a complete organism-level system, individual GmrS or GmrD proteins, individual gmrS or gmrD genes, phage IPI inhibitor proteins, and individual glucosylated hydroxymethylcytosine DNA substrate classes.
